tagline.en: Snake, Moles, Slice and Layer: play for XP and the daily top 10.
tagline.id: Snake, Moles, Slice, dan Layer: main untuk XP dan top 10 harian.

items.en: Four skill games: Snake, Moles, Slice and Layer. Works with keyboard, mouse and touch.
items.id: Empat game skill: Snake, Moles, Slice, dan Layer. Bisa pakai keyboard, mouse, dan sentuh.

items.en: Every point gives XP (up to 100 per game, 300 per day per game) and a spot on the daily top 10.
items.id: Tiap poin dapat XP (maks 100 per game, 300 per hari per game) dan kesempatan masuk top 10 harian.

items.en: Scores are checked by the server, so the board stays fair.
items.id: Skor dicek server, jadi papan skor tetap adil.
